title: Hotel Corporate Codes: a source-linked corporate-rate code dataset
description:
Hotel Corporate Codes contains 290 hotel corporate-rate code records across 10 hotel groups, plus five car-rental records, distributed as JSON and the MIT-licensed npm package @adsorgcn/hotel-corporate-codes. Of the hotel records, 286 were synchronized from HotelCorporateCodes.com; four cite official pages for IHG Global E and Wyndham Access Development, OfferFit, and Passport Unlimited. Unknown fields remain null. Historical discounts and identification reports are not current booking guarantees. A separate maintenance branch publishes reviewed source changes; incorporation into the package and website is a separate step. Data files are fixed at main commit 1a577d8; this archive also includes citation metadata.

Hotel Corporate Codes 收录 10 个酒店集团的 290 条酒店协议价代码，另附 5 条租车记录，以 JSON 和 MIT 许可的 npm 包 @adsorgcn/hotel-corporate-codes 分发。酒店记录中，286 条同步自 HotelCorporateCodes.com；4 条引用 IHG Global E 以及 Wyndham 的 Access Development、OfferFit、Passport Unlimited 官方页面。未知字段保留 null。历史折扣和身份核验报告不构成当前预订保证。独立维护分支发布经复核的来源变更；数据包和网站另行同步。数据文件固定于主线提交 1a577d8；归档另附引文元数据。

The description cites the works listed as related identifiers. Ma and Schwartz discuss fixed-percentage fenced discounts and their limitations; the other references provide background on hotel rate restrictions, customer segmentation, pricing disclosure and revenue management. The code records were not derived from these papers.

Snapshot: 1a577d8f2df5fe8d65a7d22e861e34aa8083c767. Documentation: HotelCorporateCodes.com.
